question: How do the official Gemma 4 E2B instruction-tuned LiteRT-LM CPU and GPU Android routes execute and perform on the authorized Galaxy S23 Ultra under the canonical fixed-prompt contract?

arms: official LiteRT-LM CPU artifact on the CPU backend
official LiteRT-LM GPU artifact on the GPU neural backend
excluded: other model families or Gemma sizes
host results in the Android registry

upstream_model.name: google/gemma-4-E2B-it
upstream_model.parameter_and_context_source: official upstream model card/config at the pinned revision

quantization.published_description: Gemma-4 mobile quantization using a mixture of 2-bit, 4-bit, and 8-bit weights
quantization.exact_per_tensor_assignment_missing_reas: The official deployment model card does not publish a per-tensor bit allocation or calibration manifest.
quantization.source: official deployment model card at the pinned revision

artifacts.template_equivalence_boundary: The two embedded templates differ only in a tool-response/thinking branch that is unreachable for the canonical two-message, no-tools, thinking-disabled workload. Their rendered canonical prompt bytes must match per tier and are hash-checked.

android_runner.build_mode: dynamic LiteRT accelerator resolution; CPU/GPU selected at runtime

route.sampler_configuration: TOP_P type with k=1, p=1.0, temperature=1.0, no seed

greedy_equivalence_proof.behavior: When k == 1, LiteRT-LM returns the single top-k token ID directly and labels this Greedy sampling; p, temperature, and RNG are bypassed.
greedy_equivalence_proof.reason_for_enum_adapter: v0.16.1 CreateCpuSampler implements TOP_P and returns UNIMPLEMENTED for the GREEDY and TOP_K enum values. TOP_P(k=1) reaches the documented greedy branch.

route.prompt_render_policy: Pinned Gemma 4 template specialization for exactly system+user, no tools, add_generation_prompt=true, enable_thinking=false
route.kv_reset: One direct LiteRT-LM Session is reused and RewindToStep(0) is verified before every logical request.
route.cache_policy: Each arm uses an experiment-owned cache directory cleared before setup; runtime compilation/cache creation is inside setup.

timing_and_evidence.setup_boundary: Immediately before ModelAssets::Create through one Engine and one direct Session ready with 8192-token KV capacity.
timing_and_evidence.request_boundary: Immediately before canonical prompt rendering through final callback/stop delivery.
timing_and_evidence.prefill: LiteRT-LM BenchmarkInfo prefill duration/tokens when exposed after engine callback drain; otherwise null+reason. Synchronous frontend-plus-prefill wall time is retained separately and never relabeled as isolated prefill.
timing_and_evidence.decode: First emitted token callback through final callback; numerator excludes the first emitted token. Runtime BenchmarkInfo decode observations are retained separately when exposed.
timing_and_evidence.optional_telemetry_policy: Missing/invariant runtime-internal turn counters are never a logical-request failure. Raw output and callback clocks are persisted first; unavailable splits remain null with explicit reasons.
timing_and_evidence.memory: 100 ms process PSS/VmHWM sampling plus ru_maxrss over setup and the entire arm lifecycle; GPU device memory is unavailable unless independently exposed.
timing_and_evidence.output_sanity: Exact-hash looks_sensible plus failure-only issue_notes; corruption/gibberish smoke only.

fatal_gates: wrong workload, artifact, runtime, runner, library, or device identity
prompt plus 2048 ceiling exceeds 8192 or any silent truncation
requested backend or exact k=1 greedy-equivalent sampler not applied
failure to rewind the reused session to step zero before a logical request
unauthorized/destructive device operation or lock violation
raw output cannot be bound to the claimed request and route
nullable_not_fatal: runtime-internal BenchmarkInfo counters or timing splits
GPU-private memory not visible in process PSS
phone_campaign_order: pull, hash, validate, and remove only the exact experiment-owned remote root
